batch.selection: Microsoft 405 份待审母集按冻结顺序排列的第 3 批 60 份资料
batch.admissionRule: 总分至少 6/10，且知识重要性至少 2/3

results.title: Example of shapes and projections in a knowledge store
results.description: Explore a detailed example that projects the output of a rich skillset into complex shapes that inform the structure and composition of content in a knowledge store.

scores.rationale: 页面是知识存储投影的长篇示例，核心机制已由投影总览和数据塑形资料覆盖。

results.title: Knowledge store "projections" in Azure AI Search
results.description: Introduces projection concepts and best practices. If you're creating a knowledge store in Azure AI Search, projections determine the type, quantity, and composition of objects in Azure Storage.

scores.rationale: 投影总览解释富化内容如何映射为表、对象和文件，具有稳定的数据组织价值。

results.title: Shaping data for projection into a knowledge store
results.description: Define the data structures in a knowledge store by creating data shapes and passing them to a projection.

scores.rationale: 数据塑形说明嵌套富化结果如何转换为可持久结构，方法可迁移到其他管线。

results.title: Define projections in a knowledge store
results.description: Learn how to define table, object, and file projections in a knowledge store by reviewing syntax and examples.

scores.rationale: 页面主要列出投影语法和操作示例，与总览及塑形资料重复。

results.title: OData language overview for $filter , $orderby , and $select in Azure AI Search
results.description: OData language overview for filters, select, and order-by for Azure AI Search keyword search.

scores.rationale: OData 筛选、排序和字段选择构成结构化检索表达式的通用基础。

results.title: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in Azure AI Search
results.description: Learn how Azure AI Search supports RAG patterns with agentic retrieval and classic hybrid search to ground LLM responses in your content. Get started today.

scores.rationale: RAG 总览对经典混合检索和代理检索进行统一比较，适用广但基础原理可由主资料替代。

results.title: Analyzers for text processing in Azure AI Search
results.description: Assign analyzers to searchable string fields in an index to replace default standard Lucene with custom, predefined or language-specific alternatives.

scores.rationale: 分析器的字符处理、分词和词元过滤决定关键词索引与查询的一致性。

results.title: Filters for keyword search in Azure AI Search
results.description: Filter by user security identity, language, geo-location, or numeric values to reduce search results on queries in a search index in Azure AI Search.

scores.rationale: 搜索过滤结合安全身份、语言和结构化属性，是检索约束的重要机制。

results.title: Index data from Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
results.description: Set up an Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) Gen2 indexer to automate indexing of content and metadata for full-text search in Azure AI Search.

scores.rationale: ADLS 索引器页面主要是 Azure 数据源连接和身份配置，通用知识增量不足。

results.title: Set up integrated vectorization in Azure AI Search using REST
results.description: Learn how to use the REST APIs to define an indexer pipeline that includes chunking and vectorization.

scores.rationale: REST 集成向量化串联切块、嵌入和索引管线，达到保留线但偏产品接口。

results.title: Chunk and vectorize with the Document Layout skill
results.description: Chunk textual content by headings and semantically coherent fragments using the Document Layout skill, generate embeddings, and send the results to a searchable index.

scores.rationale: 依据标题与布局进行语义切块能保留文档结构，是高质量 RAG 的重要方法。

results.title: Chunk and vectorize content with the Azure Content Understanding skill
results.description: Use preview semantic chunking and AI-based image descriptions with the Azure Content Understanding skill to build an Azure AI Search index.

scores.rationale: Content Understanding 将语义切块与图像描述结合，机制有价值但处于预览且依赖产品。

results.title: Connect to Azure Storage using a managed identity (Azure AI Search)
results.description: Learn how to set up an indexer connection to an Azure Storage account using a managed identity.

scores.rationale: 托管身份连接存储属于 Azure 权限与资源配置，不是独立 AI 技术知识。

results.title: OData $filter syntax in Azure AI Search
results.description: OData language reference and full syntax used for creating filter expressions in Azure AI Search queries.

scores.rationale: 完整 OData 过滤语法明确布尔、范围和函数表达能力，对结构化检索有长期价值。

results.title: Understand how OData collection filters work in Azure AI Search
results.description: Learn the mechanics of how OData collection filters work in Azure AI Search queries, including limitations and behaviors unique to collections.

scores.rationale: 集合过滤的量词、规范形和限制是复杂检索正确性的关键且不易从普通语法页推导。

results.title: Relevance in Azure AI Search
results.description: Learn how relevance and ranking work in Azure AI Search. Explore hybrid search, semantic reranking, agentic retrieval, and scoring profiles to improve results.

scores.rationale: 相关性总览统一关键词、混合、语义重排和代理检索的排序层次，适用面广。

results.title: Return a semantic answer in Azure AI Search
results.description: Describes the composition of a semantic answer and how to obtain answers from a result set.

scores.rationale: 语义答案的抽取、置信与返回边界直接影响可回答性和结果解释。

results.title: Configure semantic ranker and return captions in search results
results.description: Add a semantic configuration to a search index.

scores.rationale: 语义排序配置与摘要返回有实用价值，但大部分内容依赖 Azure Search 接口。

results.title: Enable or disable semantic ranker billing
results.description: Learn how to set the billing plan for semantic ranker in Azure AI Search, including how to switch between the free and standard plans.

scores.rationale: 页面只说明语义排序器计费方案的启停，不教授专业检索机制。

results.title: Use scoring profiles with semantic ranker in Azure AI Search
results.description: Learn how to combine scoring profiles with semantic ranking in Azure AI Search to optimize final document relevance.

scores.rationale: 将业务评分信号与语义重排组合，体现多阶段排序的通用设计方法。

results.title: Add semantic ranking to queries in Azure AI Search
results.description: Set a semantic query type to attach the deep learning models of semantic ranker.

scores.rationale: 语义查询请求说明重排输入与输出契约，实用但产品接口依赖较强。

results.title: Rewrite queries with semantic ranker in Azure AI Search (preview)
results.description: Learn how to rewrite queries with semantic ranker in Azure AI Search

scores.rationale: 基于语言模型的查询重写改善召回并提供多变体检索，是官方能力边界与重要机制。

results.title: Semantic ranking in Azure AI Search
results.description: Learn how semantic ranking in Azure AI Search uses deep learning language models to rerank results, improve relevance, and enhance search quality for your users.

scores.rationale: 语义重排利用语言模型对初排结果再评分，是现代搜索质量提升的核心方法。

results.title: Tutorial: Create a custom analyzer for phone numbers
results.description: Learn how to build a custom analyzer to improve the quality of search results in Azure AI Search.

scores.rationale: 电话号码自定义分析器是单一教程示例，方法已由分析器主资料完整覆盖。

results.title: Tutorial: Optimize indexing using the push API
results.description: Learn how to efficiently index data using Azure AI Search's push API. This tutorial and sample code are in C#.

scores.rationale: Push API 索引优化教程偏 C# 产品操作，缺少独立且持久的 AI 知识。

results.title: Add a filter to a vector query in Azure AI Search
results.description: Learn how to add filter expressions to vector queries in Azure AI Search. Configure prefilter, postfilter, and strict postfilter (preview) modes to optimize query performance and improve search results.

scores.rationale: 向量过滤的预过滤、后过滤与严格后过滤会改变召回和延迟，是关键检索权衡。

results.title: Assign narrow data types to vector fields in Azure AI Search
results.description: Learn how to assign narrow data types to vector fields to reduce the storage requirements of vector indexes.

scores.rationale: 窄数值类型在存储、精度和吞吐间建立工程权衡，具有通用向量系统价值。

results.title: Chunk large documents for RAG and vector search in Azure AI Search
results.description: Learn strategies for chunking PDFs, HTML files, and other large documents for agentic retrieval and vector search.

scores.rationale: 面向 RAG 的文档切块策略直接影响召回、上下文完整性和成本。

results.title: Choose an approach for optimizing vector storage and processing
results.description: Learn about the vector compression options in Azure AI Search, and how to reduce storage through narrow data types, built-in scalar or quantization, truncated dimensions, and elimination of redundant storage.

scores.rationale: 压缩、降维和去除冗余副本的组合策略是向量存储优化的系统方法。

results.title: Configure a vectorizer in a search index
results.description: Add a vectorizer to an Azure AI Search index so the search service converts text queries to vectors at query time using Microsoft-hosted or custom embedding models.

scores.rationale: 查询时向量化器把嵌入模型与索引配置绑定，明确在线向量生成契约。

results.title: Create a vector index in Azure AI Search
results.description: Learn how to create or update a vector index in Azure AI Search by defining vector fields, configuring search algorithms, and setting vector profiles.

scores.rationale: 向量索引字段、算法和配置文件的构造规则具有实用价值但偏产品实现。

results.title: Generate embeddings for search queries and documents
results.description: Learn how to generate embeddings for downstream indexing into an Azure AI Search index.

scores.rationale: 文档与查询嵌入的一致生成是向量检索正确性的基础，适用面广。

results.title: Index binary vectors for vector search
results.description: Learn how to configure fields for binary vectors and the vector search configuration for querying the fields.

scores.rationale: 二进制向量索引给出极致压缩与相似度计算边界，独特但适用场景较窄。

results.title: Compress vectors using scalar or binary quantization
results.description: Configure built-in scalar or quantization for compressing vectors on disk and in memory.

scores.rationale: 标量与二值量化在内存、延迟和召回之间的权衡是向量检索核心优化。

results.title: Create a vector query in Azure AI Search
results.description: Learn how to create vector queries that target an index in Azure AI Search.

scores.rationale: 向量查询的构造与结果解释是必要实践，但基本原理可由向量检索总览覆盖。

results.title: Eliminate optional vector instances from storage
results.description: In vector search, configure storage to exclude optional copies of vector fields, reducing the storage requirements of vector data.

scores.rationale: 去除可选向量副本展示存储成本与功能约束的明确工程权衡。

results.title: Truncate dimensions using MRL compression
results.description: Truncate dimensions on text-embedding-3 models using Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) compression.

scores.rationale: MRL 维度截断利用表示学习结构降低存储与计算，机制独特且具有长期价值。

results.title: Vector index size and limits
results.description: Learn about the factors that affect the size of a vector index.

scores.rationale: 向量索引容量限制与大小估算必须以官方契约为准，直接影响生产规划。

results.title: Integrated vector embedding in Azure AI Search
results.description: Learn how integrated vectorization in Azure AI Search automatically chunks and generates embeddings during indexing and query execution using built-in skills.

scores.rationale: 集成向量化统一切块、嵌入、索引和查询时生成，是完整检索管线的重要模式。

results.title: Multi-vector field support in Azure AI Search (preview)
results.description: Learn how Azure AI Search enables multi-vector field support for better search experiences with long-form or multimodal content.

scores.rationale: 多向量字段让长文档或多模态对象保留多个局部表示，具有独立检索价值。

results.title: Vector search in Azure AI Search
results.description: Learn about vector search in Azure AI Search for similarity matching across text, images, and multilingual content using numeric embeddings and vector indexes.

scores.rationale: 向量搜索总览系统解释嵌入、近邻索引和跨模态相似匹配。

results.title: Relevance in vector search
results.description: Learn about the concepts behind vector relevance, scoring, including how matches are found in vector space and ranked in search results.

scores.rationale: 向量相关性资料解释距离、相似度和分数转换，是正确理解检索排名的基础。

results.title: Azure Vision vectorizer (preview)
results.description: Connects to Azure Vision in Foundry Tools to generate embeddings at query time.

scores.rationale: Azure Vision 向量化器主要是单一托管服务连接，通用机制已由向量化主资料覆盖。

results.title: Azure OpenAI vectorizer
results.description: Connects to a deployed model on your Azure OpenAI resource at query time.

scores.rationale: Azure OpenAI 向量化器主要说明资源连接和参数配置，缺少独立知识增量。

results.title: Custom Web API vectorizer
results.description: Use the Custom Web API vectorizer to integrate your custom code for generating embeddings at query time.

scores.rationale: 自定义 Web API 向量化器说明外部嵌入服务的扩展契约，具备可迁移集成价值。

results.title: Vector indexes in Azure AI Search
results.description: Learn how Azure AI Search stores and manages vector indexes for similarity search, including vector field types, algorithms, and storage requirements.

scores.rationale: 向量索引的字段类型、算法和存储布局是相似度检索系统的核心知识。

results.title: Forecasting at scale: many models and distributed training
results.description: Learn about different ways to scale forecasting model training

scores.rationale: 多模型和分布式训练的预测扩展策略对大规模时间序列任务普遍重要。

results.title: Calendar features for time series forecasting in AutoML
results.description: Learn how Azure Machine Learning's AutoML creates calendar and holiday features

scores.rationale: 日历与节假日特征体现时间序列外生结构的系统化特征工程方法。

results.title: Deep learning with AutoML forecasting
results.description: Learn how Azure Machine Learning's AutoML uses deep learning to forecast time series values

scores.rationale: 深度学习预测模型的适用条件和训练方式对复杂时间序列选型有直接价值。

results.title: Inference and evaluation of forecasting models
results.description: Learn about different ways to inference and evaluate forecasting models using Azure Machine Learning.

scores.rationale: 预测模型的滚动推理与评估必须处理时间切分和多步误差，是核心方法。

results.title: Lag features for time-series forecasting in AutoML
results.description: Explore how automated machine learning (AutoML) in Azure Machine Learning creates lag and rolling window aggregation to forecast time-series regression models.

scores.rationale: 滞后与滚动窗口特征是时间序列监督学习的基础表示方法。

results.title: Overview of forecasting methods in AutoML
results.description: Learn how AutoML in Azure Machine Learning uses machine learning to build forecasting models, including time series or regression models for predictions.

scores.rationale: 预测方法总览对回归、经典统计和机器学习路径进行系统选型比较。

results.title: Model sweeping and selection for forecasting in AutoML
results.description: Explore how you can use automated machine learning (AutoML) in Azure Machine Learning to search for (sweep) and select forecasting models.

scores.rationale: 模型搜索与选择涉及验证窗口、指标和资源权衡，是 AutoML 的核心机制。

results.title: Make data-driven policies and influence decision-making
results.description: Make data-driven decisions and policies with the Responsible AI dashboard's integration of the causal analysis tool EconML.

scores.rationale: 因果分析把相关性模型扩展为干预和政策效应判断，具有重要决策价值。

results.title: Counterfactuals analysis and what-if
results.description: Generate diverse counterfactual examples with feature perturbations to see minimal changes required to achieve desired prediction with the Responsible AI dashboard's integration of DiCE machine learning.

scores.rationale: 反事实分析用最小特征改变解释预测并支持 what-if 决策，是关键可解释性方法。

results.title: Deep learning vs. machine learning in Azure Machine Learning
results.description: Learn how deep learning relates to machine learning and AI. In Azure Machine Learning, use deep learning models for fraud detection, object detection, and more.

scores.rationale: 深度学习与机器学习的基础区别已被站内核心概念完整覆盖，本页没有独立增量。

results.title: Model performance and fairness
results.description: Learn about machine learning fairness and how the Fairlearn Python package can help you assess and mitigate unfairness.

scores.rationale: 公平性评估与缓解明确群体差异、指标选择和权衡，是负责任机器学习核心。

results.title: Machine learning registries for MLOps
results.description: Learn about Azure Machine Learning registries and their role in scaling MLOps across different environments.

scores.rationale: 模型注册表跨环境共享版本与元数据，是规模化 MLOps 的重要治理机制。

results.title: Azure Machine Learning model monitoring
results.description: Learn about monitoring the performance of models deployed to production on Azure Machine Learning, including lookback windows, monitoring signals, and metrics.

scores.rationale: 生产模型监控覆盖性能、数据漂移、窗口和告警，是持续可靠性的基础。

results.title: What is Responsible AI?
results.description: Learn what Responsible AI is and how to use it with Azure Machine Learning to understand models, protect data, and control the model lifecycle.

scores.rationale: 负责任 AI 总览统一公平、解释、隐私与生命周期控制，适用于多数机器学习项目。
